about: D112: a winning run takes 25-30 minutes (it was 45-60, D30). Target bands for the run simulator (tools/balance/sim.py --check, tools/balance/report.py). Numbers come from DECISIONS.md (D14 D30 D61), balance-methods.md section 6.2, combat-spec.md section 7 and the E1 packet brief. Proposals, not owner-locked values: the owner adjusts them (D13). D186 (owner, 2026-10-17): for the class-spread pass every class aims at about 60-85% sim win rate (average profile, 2000 runs, seed 1); that band is the owner's and replaces the run_win_rate / nobody_win_rate average bands below for that pass (the numbers below are kept as the old proposals).

fight_turns._note: mean player turns of the fights the player wins, average QTE profile, greedy policy

run_win_rate._note: first-try runs; whole-run win rate per QTE skill profile, greedy decisions. The 95% interval of the estimate must overlap the band.

advisory._note: balance-methods.md section 6.2: reported in balance-report.md, not part of --check

nobody_win_rate._note: Nobody is the pure challenge class (D83, unlocked after the first win): its own band instead of the +-10 pts spread and the fight-length bands. Move 'nobody' into class_spread_classes / fight_turn_classes for the literal reading of the brief.
